imageQa.note: Intentional image-free layouts; no new or changed editorial, affiliate, or product imagery.

searchConsole.signal: Eight homepage impressions, zero clicks, average position 3.125 and no query rows
searchConsole.decision: Too little evidence for a Data-led page. The batch instead adds three unrelated evergreen intents and stronger reciprocal crawl paths from established guides.
searchConsole.ignored: The homepage-only sample was not treated as a topic signal; the externally reported 26 submitted and zero indexed sitemap URLs were treated as a discovery warning, not proof that the current 144-page sitemap is invalid.

monetization.placement: Three disclosed category searches on the chef’s-knife guide only; no commerce on the health-plan or adjustable-bench pages.

authority.action: Created a source-backed 2027 Marketplace health-plan comparison record that normalizes annual premium, deductible, cost sharing, out-of-pocket exposure, provider network, drug coverage and plan-document evidence before enrollment.
authority.cluster: Well-run money systems, health coverage decisions and documented household risk
authority.opportunity: CMS/HealthCare.gov consumer-education and state insurance-department review opportunities logged; no outreach sent.

diversity: A time-sensitive household coverage worksheet, a home-strength equipment qualification and a cooking-tool purchase decision answer three unrelated questions across Life and Fitness. Search Console did not support a Data-led item, so the portfolio uses one Authority-expansion and two Exploration pages.
